app.name: Class & Routine
app.tagline: Your university routine, in one place.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: The app is being set up. Features arrive step by step.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are not valid. Please check and try again.
errors.SECOND_STEP_REQUIRED: Please finish the second sign-in step.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: Your session check failed. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.STATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Your account cannot use this yet.
errors.CONFLICT: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Use your university email address (for example name@baiust.ac.bd).
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is not correct.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account cannot sign in. Please contact your department.
errors.CAPTCHA_REQUIRED: Please complete the check to continue.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.CODE_INVALID: That code is not valid or has expired.
errors.LAST_DOMAIN: At least one email domain must remain.

password.error: Use 8 to 128 characters with at least one letter and one number.

new_password.error: Use 8 to 128 characters with at least one letter and one number.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.emailHint: Use your university address, for example name@baiust.ac.bd.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
signup.departmentsUnavailable: The department list is not available yet.
signup.shortCodeHint: The 1 to 10 letter code used for you in the routine, for example SK.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If the address can be used, we sent a message with the next step. The link works once and lasts 24 hours.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.expired: The link has expired or was already used. Enter your email and we will send a new one.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Open the link we emailed you to continue. You can ask for a new link below.
verifyEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.

login.title: Sign in
login.wait: Too many tries. You can try again in {seconds} seconds.

secondStep.title: Second step
secondStep.body: Enter the 6 digit code from your authenticator app.
secondStep.emailSent: We emailed you a code. It works once and lasts 10 minutes.

totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
totp.body: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digit code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manualKey: Or type this key into the app:

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your university email. If there is an account, we will send a link that lasts 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If the account exists, we sent a link. Check your email.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.missing: This reset link is not valid. Ask for a new one.

changePassword.title: Account
changePassword.heading: Change your password
changePassword.done: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.

holding.joinBody: Your email is confirmed. The form to join your section is coming soon.
holding.waitingBody: Your request is waiting for approval. We will email you when it is decided.
holding.updateBody: A new semester has started. The semester update form is coming soon.
